title: Experiment hive quality
description: Grades completed whole-hive experiments against outcome, efficiency, and speed dimensions so hive-level experiments become trendable scorecards.

criteria.title: Hive outcome
criteria.model: The selected hive variant reaches the scenario's intended outcome.
criteria.method: Read the selected arm's outcome score and baseline comparison from the experiment scorecard evidence.
criteria.driftMarkers: Outcome score is low, unknown, or missing while the experiment declares a winner.

criteria.title: Hive efficiency
criteria.model: The selected hive variant reaches the outcome without excessive coordination, token, cost, or retry waste.
criteria.method: Read the selected arm's efficiency score and total cost from the experiment scorecard evidence.
criteria.driftMarkers: Efficiency degrades while outcome stays healthy.

criteria.title: Hive speed
criteria.model: The selected hive variant progresses at an acceptable pace for the scenario.
criteria.method: Read the selected arm's speed score from the experiment scorecard evidence.
criteria.driftMarkers: Speed is degraded or unknown across repeated hive experiments.
